title: Parts Price Index for Earlier Repair Parts — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Index table — Service Accounts and Repair Orders repeat repair estimates.** The parts price index follows the age of the earlier repair:

| Earlier repair's line date, in whole months before the diagnosis | Earlier parts list price |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | raised by 0.06 of itself |
| At least 12 and fewer than 24 | raised by 0.03 of itself |
| Fewer than 12 | used as recorded |

The diagnosis is the line date of the latest diagnostic fee on the account. A whole month is complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Hypothetical.** An earlier parts list price of 350.00 is indexed to 371.00 at 26 whole months, to 360.50 at 14, and stays 350.00 at 8.
